records.title: Coordinate Chart Sensitivity of the Drift-Control Ratio
records.critique_question: Do undifferentiated full-state norms, realized-input shares ||f||/(||f||+||Gu||), or raw drift components -M^-1 h change under nonlinear coordinate maps q |-> phi(q)?
records.alternative_mechanism: Drift acceleration is chart-dependent under q |-> phi(q) because acceleration picks up Jacobian derivative terms; only control effect magnitudes built from covariant input maps are chart-consistent. Unweighted norms and realized-input ratios therefore vary with parameterization.
records.discriminating_measurement: Evaluate canonical DCR_W,U on acceleration blocks with declared W and admissible U across minimal and maximal charts; compare with DIR using realized u; record whether drift ||a_d||_M matches across charts.
records.required_instrumentation: Coordinate transformation engine; declared W and U; minimal vs maximal coordinate simulators.
records.falsification_threshold: Same-state canonical DCR differs by more than 0.10 across charts only when W, U, or acceleration convention changes; drift ||a_d||_M alone need not match across charts.

records.title: Neuromuscular Reflex Feedback in Drift-Control Partitioning
records.critique_question: Do involuntary spinal stretch reflexes u_reflex(q, q_dot) shift state-dependent feedback between drift f(x) and voluntary control G(x)u?
records.alternative_mechanism: Rapid monosynaptic and polysynaptic stretch reflexes (30-60 ms latency) generate state-dependent joint torques that mimic passive mechanical plant impedance, blurring the theoretical distinction between autonomous drift and intentional control.
records.discriminating_measurement: Compare open-loop generalized torque-driven Tier 1 rigid body models against reflex-enabled Tier 3 musculoskeletal models under unexpected kinematic perturbation trials during the downswing.
records.required_instrumentation: High-density surface EMG array; transient torque-perturbation robotic handle; Tier 3 Hill-type neuromuscular reflex simulation.
records.falsification_threshold: Perturbation-induced reflexive torque modulation exceeding 20% of nominal voluntary control torque within 50 ms of mechanical perturbation.

records.title: Impact Interval Truncation and Finite Contact Duration
records.critique_question: Does pre-impact Drift-Control Ratio evaluated at t_impact^- retain predictive authority over ball launch conditions given finite contact duration [t_0, t_1]?
records.alternative_mechanism: During the approximately 450 microsecond collision window, clubhead-ball deformation, high-frequency structural waves, and localized compliance dominate post-impact trajectory, decoupling pre-impact rigid-body acceleration ratios from launch outcomes.
records.discriminating_measurement: Execute UpstreamDrift fail-closed audit_impact_interval across Tier 2 compliant viscoelastic contact solvers (Hunt-Crossley, Hertzian contact) against experimental ball launch and restitution data.
records.required_instrumentation: Ultra-high-speed video (>= 20,000 fps); dynamic contact force sensors; fail-closed impact interval audit suite.
records.falsification_threshold: Failure of momentum-energy balance audit or greater than 5% divergence in ball launch speed between instantaneous coefficient-of-restitution models and continuous contact integration.
